path.?dataset_path: The dataset path, whish stores the datasets
path.?train_result_path: The path to store the training results
path.?test_result_path: The path to store the testing results

tiff_cut.?tiffcut_source_image: Path to the large TIFF image that needs to be sliced
tiff_cut.?tiffcut_source_label: YOLO-format label file (normalized coords) that matches the source image
tiff_cut.?tiffcut_output_dir: Directory that will receive the cropped tiles (images/ & labels/)
tiff_cut.?tiffcut_overlap_rate: Fractional overlap between image tiles (e.g. 0.2 = 20% overlap)
tiff_cut.?tiffcut_save_empty: Whether to export tiles without any boxes
tiff_cut.?tiff_cut_output_ext: Image extension for the exported tiles

pretrained_model.?pretrained_model_path: The pre_trained_model uesd for fine-tuning or testing

train.?train_MAR1: The training parameters for MAR1 dataset

train_MAR1.?batch_size: The batch size used for training
train_MAR1.?img_size: The image size used for training
train_MAR1.?epochs: The number of epochs used for training
train_MAR1.?lr: The learning rate used for training
train_MAR1.?patience: The patience used for training, if serveral epochs no improvement, then stop training
train_MAR1.?train_data_yaml_path: The data yaml path for MAR1 dataset

train_AIR-SARShip.?batch_size: The batch size used for training
train_AIR-SARShip.?img_size: The image size used for training
train_AIR-SARShip.?epochs: The number of epochs used for training
train_AIR-SARShip.?lr: The learning rate used for training
train_AIR-SARShip.?patience: The patience used for training, if serveral epochs no improvement, then stop training
train_AIR-SARShip.?train_data_yaml_path: The data yaml path for AIR-SARShip dataset

validate_MAR1.?validate_subdataset: The subdataset used for validation, may containing: test,train,val
validate_MAR1.?validate_model_path: The model path used for validation
validate_MAR1.?validate_data_yaml_path: The data yaml path for MAR1 dataset

validate_AIR-SARShip.?validate_subdataset: The subdataset used for validation, may containing: test,train,val
validate_AIR-SARShip.?validate_model_path: The model path used for validation
validate_AIR-SARShip.?validate_data_yaml_path: The data yaml path for AIR-SARShip dataset

test_MAR1.?test_img_path: The image path used for testing
test_MAR1.?test_output_path: The output path to store the testing results
test_MAR1.?test_weights_path: The model weights path used for testing
test_MAR1.?use_label: Whether to load ground-truth label during single-image test

test_AIR-SARShip.?test_img_path: The image path used for testing
test_AIR-SARShip.?batch_test_img_path: The directory path containing images for batch testing
test_AIR-SARShip.?test_output_path: The output path to store the testing results
test_AIR-SARShip.?test_weights_path: The model weights path used for testing
test_AIR-SARShip.?use_label: Whether to load ground-truth label during single-image test
test_AIR-SARShip.?test_augment: Whether to use augment during single-image test
test_AIR-SARShip.?test_visualize: 是否输出图像和地理位置信息
test_AIR-SARShip.?show_pred_panel: 控制是否输出结果图像

visualization.?visualization_target_patch_size: Detection crop size (pixels) when exporting target-centered sub-images
visualization.?visualization_patch_output_dir: Directory used to store exported detection sub-images
visualization.?use_latlon: Whether to output lon/lat when CRS is available during visualization
